Annotators were asked to judge each generated path for contextual relevance to the question/sentence and select: 1) CoSe-Co better, 2) PGQA better, 3) both similar.

We asked them to compare the paths based on their contextual relevance with the complete sentence and classify them into one of three categories -1) 'CoSe-Co is better than PGQA', 2) 'PGQA is better than CoSe-Co', 3) 'Both are of the similar quality'.
